typography.notes: Headings must use 'Outfit' with tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter) for a bold, modern, and futuristic look. Body text uses 'Manrope' (leading-relaxed) for maximum readability in dark environments. DO NOT use Inter for headings.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10' for cards, sticky floating headers, and panels.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use layered box-shadows: 'shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(108,99,255,0.15)]' for hovering states on primary cards to feel neon and energetic.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Implement 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#6C63FF] via-[#00D4FF] to-[#FF6FD8]' for CTA buttons, key headings (with 'bg-clip-text text-transparent'), and subtle border accents.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Strictly 20–24px (rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl) for all main containers and cards.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Sections should have py-24 or py-32 to give elements breathing room. Use the 'Bento Grid' approach for the About Me and Work sections to create asymmetry and visual tension.
layout_and_spacing.grid_gaps: gap-6 or gap-8 between bento items.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, tags, and dense content. Headings can be left-aligned or centered depending on the section symmetry.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards must elevate slightly ('-translate-y-2') and increase border opacity + glow shadow on hover.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_animations: Elements should fade in and translate up gracefully using framer-motion as the user scrolls. Stagger list items.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Gradient buttons should have a sweeping animated gradient background or an intense glow ring on hover.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Apply subtle parallax effects to floating elements in the hero using framer-motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Secondary text should be a light readable gray (#A1A1AA) instead of dark gray.

universal_guidelines: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions to specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
Do NOT center align the app container. No '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for automated testing.
Never use generic AI emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays, headers, or anything with content under it. Add a blur or dark semi-transparent bg.
Never apply a Vercel/Stripe default look. Make it cinematic and edgy.
Use named exports for components and default exports for pages.
Use .jsx / .js extensions for components instead of .tsx since this project uses JS.
